Bundled OCR dependencies for Screen AI Translator 1.4.0

ONNX Runtime 1.22.1 (Microsoft, MIT):
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.22.1
Distributed from the Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime NuGet package.
The package's LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt accompany the runtime.

PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 / PP-OCRv6 and PP-LCNet text-line orientation (PaddleOCR, Apache-2.0):
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
ONNX conversions distributed by RapidOCR (Apache-2.0):
https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR/files?Revision=v3.10.0
https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR/files?Revision=master
https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR
Models: ch_PP-OCRv5_det_mobile, ch_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile,
en_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile, korean_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile,
ch_PP-OCRv5_det_server, PP-OCRv6_rec_small,
ch_PP-LCNet_x1_0_textline_ori_cls_server.
Recognition dictionaries are embedded in the models.

Models are distributed unchanged. Local filenames are det.onnx, det-server.onnx,
rec-ja.onnx, rec-ja-server.onnx, rec-en.onnx, rec-ko.onnx and cls.onnx.
The server detector, PP-OCRv6 recognizer and orientation classifier are optional
upgrades: a delivery that omits them falls back to the mobile weights and
horizontal-only recognition. Pinned source URLs and SHA256 values are in
scripts/Get-Ocr.ps1; selection evidence is in docs/reverse/ocr-selection.md.

The application supplies its own native horizontal-text preprocessing,
connected-component geometry extraction, CTC decoding and 0/180-degree crop
correction. No Python, PaddlePaddle, OpenCV, GPU runtime, or Windows OCR language
pack is required on the target machine.
